ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportFormyPlatnosci' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportFormyPlatnosci;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportFormyPlatnosci] @rowVersion bigint, @pointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN
--Kon:CzasModyfikacji --PFP:CzasModyfikacji SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @dbts bigint = cast(@@DBTS as bigint)
select @rowVersion+1 as [@RowVersion], ( select Kon_LP as [@Id], RTRIM(case when PFP_NazwaPOS is null or PFP_NazwaPOS = '' then LEFT(Kon_Wartosc,20) else PFP_NazwaPOS end) as [@Name], case when Kon_Lp between 10 and 19 then 1 when Kon_Lp between 20 and 39 then 2 when Kon_Lp between 40 and 49 then 4 when Kon_Lp between 50 and 59 then 3 else 1 end as [@Type], case when isnull(FRO_DlaDetalu,0) = 1 and isnull(PFP_KARNumer,0) <> 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsActive] from cdn.konfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on PSa_ID = @pointOfSaleId join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID left join cdn.picostanowiskaformypl on kon_lp = PFP_FormaNr and PFP_PSaID = psa_id left join cdn.FrmObiekty on KON_Numer=FRO_GIDTyp AND KON_Lp=FRO_GIDNumer AND FRO_FRMID = pck_CentrumId where Kon_Numer = 736 for xml path('PaymentForm'), type) for xml path('PaymentForms') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportFormyPlatnosci TO CDNRaport
